faq.q: Can I bring my own photographer?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. You can bring your own photographer or hire one locally. The boat charter does not include a photographer. If you need recommendations, we can suggest professionals based in Marbella who specialise in sunset shoots.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a photoshoot?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal for a 2-hour sunset session. Both have spacious decks and photo-friendly lines. For larger groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours, with a free jet ski.

data.body_html:
Imagine the golden light of the Costa del Sol spilling across the Mediterranean as you pose on the bow of a private yacht. A Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2039 from Puerto Banús gives you exactly that: a two-hour charter timed to catch the best light, with a licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks included. Whether you’re an influencer, a couple, or a brand, this is your chance to capture stunning images against the Marbella coastline.

Why choose a sunset yacht photoshoot in Marbella?

Sunset on the Med lasts about 30–40 minutes of pure golden hour. On a private yacht, you control the backdrop—Puerto Banús skyline, the Sierra Blanca mountains, or the open sea. No crowds, no distractions. The Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2039 is designed for quality over quantity: 2 hours, one sunset, maximum 12 guests.

Our recommended boats for your photoshoot

For a 2-hour sunset session, we suggest the Tier A boats. Both are 12.5m, well-maintained, and photogenic. Here’s a quick comparison:

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and VAT. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is available from €4,719 for 4 hours, with a free jet ski for action shots.

What’s included in the session?

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel and full insurance
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Safety equipment and life jackets
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – no hidden fees
  • 2-hour charter timed to sunset

You bring the camera, outfits, and vision. We handle the logistics.

Best spots for your Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session

The skipper knows the local waters. Popular photo locations include:

  • Puerto Banús entrance – with the iconic yachts and luxury boutiques in the background.
  • Golden Mile coastline – villas and palm trees behind you.
  • Cala del Faro – a quiet cove with dramatic cliffs.
  • Open sea – pure water and sky, no land in frame.

Your skipper will adjust the route based on wind, sea state, and your creative brief.

Pricing and booking details

The Marbella photoshoot yacht sunset session 2039 starts at €749 for 2 hours on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. For larger boats or extended time, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. All prices include VAT and the items listed above. A 50% deposit secures your date; balance due 7 days before departure.

To book, visit our main page and contact us via WhatsApp or the booking form.

Tips for a successful sunset photoshoot

  • Arrive 15 minutes early to board and set up.
  • Bring a light jacket – sea breeze can be cool after sunset.
  • Plan outfits that contrast with the golden light (white, navy, pastels work well).
  • Use a polarising filter to reduce glare on the water.
  • Shoot in RAW for better editing flexibility.
  • Coordinate poses with the skipper – they can position the boat for optimal light.
